dedupe_keys.name: emilia romagna dam emergency plan ped flood wave scenarios for 19 dams and 2 flood detention basins

description: This series from the Emilia-Romagna regional civil protection agency gives, for 19 dams (among them Suviana, Ridracoli, Quarto, Isola Serafini and Mignano) and the Crostolo and Secchia flood detention basins, the layers delimiting the areas potentially affected by the flood wave from a dam collapse and from the operation or malfunction of the outlet works, as set out in each dam's approved emergency plan (Piano di Emergenza Diga, PED). The Agenzia Regionale per la Sicurezza Territoriale e la Protezione Civile produced it; the series was created on 1 November 2023 and the per-dam datasets were published between 2024 and 2026. Coverage is regional, the Emilia-Romagna region of Italy. Each dam's layers are a free download as a zipped shapefile, with a WMS service, from the regional geoportal and data.europa.eu, under CC BY 4.0 with no access limits. Caveats: the scenarios are those of the approved plans, not new hydraulic runs, the layers are per dam with no single combined file, and the metadata are in Italian. Simulation uses: inundation extents downstream of dams for hazard exposure of infrastructure and emergency response planning. Related record: dam-break simulations for the ten largest dams of Pernambuco, Brazil (data-pernambuco-dam-break-simulations-10-largest-dams).
